design_stage: Separate structural sensitivity registered after inspecting schema and selected engineering/structural values of available preregistered members, before model fits, predictions, held errors or comparisons. aff102 and aff103 have no named time_PotMem; the stored vectors PotMem, Length, and Force share the stored time vector length. A reader also observed two irregular aff015 trials. The original stricter two-clock test and all its exclusions stay primary and separate. The sensitivity retains included source two-clock rows unchanged and adds source-verified one-deposited-time rows only.
scope: Same nine development members/three prefix folds and previously identified pilot, no reserve or additional members. Candidate trials have time_PotMem genuinely absent from the MATLAB struct. A malformed/present electrical clock or an irregular separate clock cannot be rescued by this path. All other original clock/bin/QC/label rules apply.
documentation: The authors describe time as the precision of the kinematic and kinetic data, PotMem as measured raw sensory potential and spiketimes as indices of threshold crossings; DOI 10.5061/dryad.vdncjsxsw, embedded README SHA256 9db6501da98a4ce10345a2de57fa9d839e8b4ad3bd7591d1ab3549efbe5eebe4. The README also contrasts nominal group kinematic rates. It does not explicitly authenticate a distinct electrical clock for these recordings. Require direct additional source corroboration below; native absolute seconds, rates and sign reported without file-specific amplitude calibration.
recording_gate: Within each candidate member all trials having an absent separate electrical clock must have a nonempty known protocol label, identity and matching label count, observed Length, Force and PotMem vectors each equal in length to finite strictly monotonically increasing time; regular cumulative lattice within 1e-8s, integer number >=2 native samples per 20ms. Every archived spike must be finite, strictly increasing, within recording and within 1e-8s of a unique actual time sample as stored absolute seconds. Never translate index, rescale seconds, truncate stimulation intervals, infer an unprovided offset, interpolate, or use the README rather than the actual measured clock. For every such trial require archived ISI and firing_rate vectors corresponding exactly in cardinality to the intervals with residual <=1e-8s and <=1e-7Hz + 1e-7 relative respectively. If any candidate trial fails these structural timing/event checks, retain that whole member outside the sensitivity, with recorded reasons.
voltage_check: Confirm a stereotyped raw PotMem transient at original threshold timestamps. For each trial use all actual ticks whose complete ±1.5ms native window is in range both at the actual tick and with +3.7,+6.1,+12.3ms offsets (native nearest sample using floor(x + 0.5)). Keep identical events at each offset and require all four raw-potential segments finite. Use every eligible event, subtract the per-segment mean, then average waveforms in each trial and compute maximum minus minimum of that mean voltage waveform. This is sign-invariant; record signed minimum/maximum/latency and native ranges. Require at least 10 comparable events for a trial to contribute to source corroboration; this threshold affects voltage corroboration only, not event counts. For an eligible member require at least 2 corroboration trials (or its only trial if there is exactly one), median across its contributing trials of (zero-offset amplitude - maximum of the 3 shifted amplitudes) >0, and strictly greater zero-offset amplitude than every shift for >50% of those trials. No score-driven thresholds or offset choice. Report all failures and low-event counts. If the timing or voltage proof fails, do not admit any single-clock trial from that member.
features_and_semantics: Same windows, features, labels, masks and chronological slicing as SOURCE-FREEZE. The single stored axis has no independently deposited electrical timestamps; it anchors event times and same-length voltage, backed by redundant intervals and event-triggered raw signal corroboration. Describe common stored timing basis only. Source rows must carry clock_route="two_clock" or "one_deposited_time". If fewer than all three folds remain after the gates, report the gap; no new rescue, reserve opening or automatic relaxing gates.
outputs: Primary private/windows.npz and bin-mask.npz retain original eligibility with clock_route="two_clock"; private/sensitivity/windows.npz and bin-mask.npz contain original valid two_clock rows plus supported one_deposited_time rows. All one-clock corroboration is separate from future outcome scores. Native traces remain private default; public code may reconstruct source.
